options.text: Hypothetically, could an officer be persuaded to bend a rule?
How do things really get done around here, off the books?
I've heard officers have... flexible arrangements sometimes.
Surely rank comes with certain, let's say, opportunities?
I'm told coin opens doors that keys can't.
Between us — does your ledger have a private page?
Would a generous friend find life easier around your camp?
Everyone has a price. What's yours?
You strike me as a practical sort. Practically speaking, are you buyable?
What does discretion cost in this camp?
Is your loyalty as fixed as they say, or just expensive?
What would it take for you to forget you saw me sometime?
How much to look the other way, generally speaking?
Give me a number for a small blindness.
What's the going rate for an officer's silence?
If I needed a patrol rerouted, what would that cost?
Price me a favor: one gate, one night, nothing said.
What do sealed lips weigh in emeralds?
Say I needed a report to go missing. Cost?
Could a donation adjust a schedule, and at what rate?
Eight emeralds says you know where your rivals camp.
Ten emeralds for the location of your enemy's base.
Six emeralds. Point me at your rivals' door.
There's eight emeralds here for a mark on my map.
I'll pay ten for what your scouts know about the other side.
Six green reasons to share where your enemies sleep.
Sell me the enemy's position. Eight emeralds, now.
Ten emeralds buys their coordinates, yes?
Take these six and draw me the rival camp.
Eight gems for one honest arrow on a chart.
For ten emeralds, whisper me where the other flag flies.
I'm buying enemy intel today. Eight emeralds on the table.
Ten in green stone for the path to their gates.
Five emeralds to remember me kindly.
A little something to smooth things between us. Four emeralds.
Six emeralds, and maybe my name sounds nicer in your reports.
Take five for your trouble. And your goodwill.
Four emeralds toward a friendlier arrangement.
Here's six. Consider me a supporter of your career.
Five gems to keep our dealings pleasant.
A gratuity, officer. Four emeralds' worth.
Six emeralds, no receipt necessary.
Five for the officer who decides how welcome I am.
Seven emeralds to soften what your file says about me.
Five emeralds and my past stays in the past, yes?
Six for a kind edit to my reputation here.
Take seven and lose whatever complaint has my name on it.
Five emeralds says my last mistake was never seen.
Six emeralds to shorten my list of sins. Officially.
Seven gems for a blind eye on my next visit.
Five to reclassify me from problem to guest.
Eight emeralds for whatever favors you're selling.
Here's six up front. Surprise me with the favor.
Four emeralds. Just take them and owe me one.
Seven for you, and I ask nothing more. Deal?
An open bribe, officer: five emeralds, terms flexible.
Eight gems, and you decide what they buy.
Six emeralds on good faith. Don't disappoint me.
Take four now; we'll settle the details later.
Let's not pretend you're honest. Name your bribe or I'll name it for you.
Every officer skims. Take the emeralds and drop the act.
Your integrity is a costume. I've got ten emeralds that say so.
Take the payoff, or I'll tell your command you already did.

negative: My price? Higher than your life savings and lower than my patience. Move on.
You probe like a bad sapper. Loudly. Dig elsewhere.
neutral: Everyone bends, yes. Mine is denominated in things you don't carry.
Careful words get careful answers. That was neither.
positive: Ha! Friend, buy me a drink like a normal person and stop auditioning for a court-martial.
My price is vodka and victory. You can afford one. Bring it openly.

negative: This conversation is approaching a reportable offense. Choose your next sentence like it's evidence.
I log solicitation attempts. I am currently deciding whether that's what this was.
neutral: Rules don't take nights off here. Neither do I. Rephrase or move along.
If that was a test of integrity, mark it passed. If it wasn't, mark yourself lucky.
positive: Friend, the answer is no, and I'm choosing to believe you were joking. Confirm my belief.
My arrangement is with the flag. It pays badly and I keep it anyway. That's your answer.

negative: You fish in a dry well with a bright hook. The desert sees the hook. So do I.
Some words are knives shown handle-first. I see the blade anyway.
neutral: In the desert, every gift has a shadow. Show me the gift and I will read its shadow.
You ask the way a jackal circles. Sit like a guest or circle elsewhere.
positive: Friend, between us things are given, not priced. Learn the difference and you'll need no purse.
The dance of gifts has steps, and asking the cost is not one of them. Watch, then dance.

negative: Say price again and discover mine is paid in teeth.
The last man who called us buyable is holding a shovel somewhere very cold.
neutral: Bold mouth. The quota has a slot for bold mouths.
That line earns most people a ditch. You get a warning. Once.
positive: Ha! Big words, little wallet. Sit down, comedian, before the sergeant hears.
Friend, my honor is cheap but my temper is free. Don't shop for either.

negative: That statement is now in the log verbatim. Its consequences are pending your next word.
Accusing an officer of corruption is itself an incident. You are one incident over budget.
neutral: Watch your phrasing, civilian. My memory has excellent retention and a filing habit.
You mistake courtesy for availability. Correct that before I file it.
positive: Even from you, friend, that lands badly. Retract it and we'll blame the heat.
I'll pretend the wind said that, and remind the wind that I report everything else.

negative: Loud offers wake the wrong sleepers. Some of them are mine. Some are worse.
You shake coins at a viper's hole. The hole has opinions.
neutral: The desert hears everything twice: once when spoken, once when regretted.
Bluntness is a northern luxury. Here it costs extra. Speak softer.
positive: Friend, you wield honesty like a club. Among us it should be a fan. Waft, don't swing.
Even friendship cannot buy what you just asked for aloud. Ask it quieter or never.

negative: Looking away costs more than looking at you is worth. Bad market for you.
Reroute a patrol? The patrol would notice. Patrols hate math errors that bleed.
neutral: There's no menu, and if there were, you couldn't read it without joining.
Officially: no rate exists. Unofficially: also no rate. The war ate it.
positive: Friend, my silence is free — I'm too tired to gossip. My favors cost sweat, not stones.
Ha, buy the whole line a hot meal and every eye goes conveniently soft. That's the only rate card.

negative: Quoting a price would be a crime. Asking for one already was. We're at one crime. Hold.
The rate for my silence is your immediate departure. Payable now.
neutral: No figure exists. This command audits itself for fun. I'm not dying for your errand.
Schedules move by orders, not donations. That's the entire pricing structure.
positive: Friend, don't make me choose between liking you and reporting you. The paperwork wins ties.
I'll give you this for free: whatever you're planning, plan it somewhere unaudited.

negative: You price silence like it's cloth. Here silence is water. And you are far from the well.
The gate you want opened has a keeper. The keeper has a memory. The memory has your face now.
neutral: In the souk everything has a number. This is not the souk. This is the tent where numbers sleep.
What you ask is not bought with green stones. It is grown from years. You have brought neither.
positive: Friend, ask me for the favor plainly, without the purse, and watch what friendship does.
Keep the emeralds. Bring me a story I haven't heard and we will discuss doors.

negative: Stones first... counted... good. The camp you want sits where my thumb is. Now forget my face harder than I forget yours.
Sold. Their fires burn there — mark it. This meeting was two ghosts and a rumor.
neutral: War economics. Their position, your map, my pocket. Everyone leaves educated.
The line hates them more than it loves rules. There's your mark. Spend it violently.
positive: For you, half price would've done, friend. There — their gate, their weak wall. Send them our regards, unsigned.
Ha, coin for what I'd tell you drunk anyway. Their camp. Go make our winter interesting.

negative: This exchange is off-log, deniable, and never happening again. Grid follows. Lose my name on the way out.
Consider this a sanctioned leak, minus the sanction. Coordinates. Go. We never overlapped.
neutral: Their position is drawn on the back of this supply form. The form never existed. Neither did you.
I'm rationalizing this as accelerated intelligence sharing. Here's the location. Audit me never.
positive: Between friends and off any record: they moved their base here. Hit the tents at dawn and thank me by winning.
Your emeralds fund the unit's blind spots. Their camp — this ridge, this bearing. We spoke of weather only.

negative: The stones vanish. So does my memory of you. Their tents darken the wadi east of the split rock. Walk away slowly.
Coin buys the map; discretion buys your exit. Their camp lies where I have drawn. Use both purchases.
neutral: Sand tells us where our rivals sleep. Green stones make the sand talkative. Listen: there.
A fair dance: you gave, I point. Their fires sit beyond the third dune line. The wind saw nothing.
positive: For a friend the price was theater, but theater keeps us honest. Their camp — here. May your shadow reach it first.
Take back one emerald for luck. The rest buys this: their walls, their gate, their sleeping hour. Go with the cold wind.

negative: Mm. Heavy pockets, light conscience. Fine — your name grates less today. Buy nothing else.
Accepted. This buys you less watched, not welcome. Know the difference. It's armed.
neutral: The stones fall into the boot. The boot forgets things. Your name, gently, among them.
Practical. The front respects practical. Your file grows a little moss over the sharp parts.
positive: Ha! Bribing friends — you're becoming one of us. Fine, fine, the good word gets louder.
Friend, you didn't need to. But the mess fund disagrees, so: gratefully pocketed.

negative: This never occurred. Your flag stays, but I'll contextualize it in the briefings. Leave before my integrity reports for duty.
Confiscated as evidence. Evidence of generosity. Your record reads one shade lighter. Vanish.
neutral: Logging this as a civilian donation with imprecise routing. Your name earns adjectives. Mild ones.
Processed into the discretionary fund. Discretion, accordingly, follows. Don't test its range.
positive: Friend, this is unnecessary and technically several violations. The unit fund and I overrule ourselves. Noted warmly.
Fine. Filed under morale expenses. Your welcome upgrades from open-door to open-mess.

negative: The gift enters the tent, and the tent's opinion of you softens like evening. Do not mistake dusk for friendship.
Taken, weighed, understood. The knives speak of you more quietly now. Quieter is not silent.
neutral: Ah, you begin to learn the dance. The gift is graceful, the timing fair. Your name gains a cushion.
A gift with open eyes. The camp accepts, and the wind carries fewer complaints about you.
positive: Between friends the gift-dance is pure pleasure. Your steps improve, your welcome deepens. Tea, first.
You honor the custom, friend. What you gave returns as smoothness in every dealing. So it has always worked.

negative: Paid. Your sins don't vanish — they get bored and wander to the back pages.
Fine. The ledger develops a smudge exactly your shape. Smudges wash off. Behave.
neutral: The file gains a coffee stain over the interesting parts. Clumsy me.
Consider your record winterized. Covered, not gone. Spring reveals everything, eventually.
positive: Friend, your page was nearly clean. Now it's clean and profitable. The war economy thanks you.
Ha! Paying to erase what we'd already forgiven. Free money. The stove fund salutes.

negative: Your complaint file just suffered a filing accident. Accidents recur if funded. Dismissed.
Amended: hostile individual becomes individual. Editing fees received. Go before I proofread.
neutral: A clerical review found your record reviewable. It reviewed favorably. Coincidence, officially.
Your entries are reclassified pending nothing. Enjoy the ambiguity. It's what you paid for.
positive: Friend, there was nothing to expunge, so I've backdated some praise instead. We're both criminals now. Welcome.
Paid to polish a clean slate. I'll engrave a commendation on it. Small one. Tasteful.

negative: The sand accepts your stones and shifts. What was written of you blurs at the edges. Edges only.
Bought: one veil across old footprints. Veils are thin. Walk lighter than before.
neutral: The camp's memory of you grows a merciful haze. Mercy purchased is still mercy. Barely.
Your history here gains a kind narrator. Narrators can be re-hired by anyone. Remember that.
positive: Friend, your name needed no washing, so the payment becomes perfume. It travels ahead of you now.
You paid to be forgiven and were already loved. The stones become gifts for the children. Fitting end.

negative: And... gone. Into the boot. What did it buy? The lesson. Lessons here are expensive.
The line thanks you for the donation. The favor? Never existed. Neither did this conversation. Run along.
You paid a wolf to owe you. Wolves don't owe. Wolves eat. Today, cheaply.
neutral: Taken. And in return: nothing, delivered promptly. Vostok efficiency.
Your emeralds enlisted. They serve the line now. They send no letters home.
positive: Ha ha! Friend, you handed money to an army and expected change. The stew tonight honors your innocence.
Pocketed! Consider it tuition. Course title: Never Do That Again. You passed.

negative: Contraband confiscated per protocol. The favor you imagined was never on offer. File a complaint. Please. I'll frame it.
Your bribe has been seized as evidence of your bribe. Elegant, isn't it? Dismissed.
Assets forfeited. In exchange you receive: continued liberty. Market rate, honestly.
neutral: Unmarked funds surrendered to the duty officer. That's me. The duty officer thanks you. Nothing further.
Received, logged as anonymous donation, and spent on your continued disappointment.
positive: Friend, I warned you once about arrangements. Now the mess has new kettles and you have wisdom. Fair trade.
Seized with a smile. The favor fairy isn't real, but the unit fund is. You've made it very happy.

negative: The desert swallows coins and curiosity alike. You will receive what the desert always returns: silence.
A gift given foolishly becomes a lesson given free. The stones stay. The lesson is yours to carry.
You bought smoke. Here is your smoke — see how it slips the fingers? Beautiful. Gone.
neutral: The stones asked something. The answer is no. The stones stay with the answer's keeper. Custom.
You watered a mirage. The mirage is grateful, in its way. It waves.
positive: Ah, friend. You paid the tent and the tent kept it, laughing. Sit — the tea your emeralds bought is excellent.
Between friends, this is called a joke you funded. We will tell it for years. You may laugh too.

negative: You call the line bought?! The line buries the buyers! Out — before we show you our currency!
That was your last insult. The count opens a fresh page with your name at the top. Run.
neutral: Wrong soldier, wrong day, wrong joke. Now you'll meet the right consequences.
You shook coins at the line's honor. The line answers in iron. Go — quickly — it's already moving.
positive: Even friendship has a floor and you just dug through it. Get out before the shovels come back up.
Friend or not, that word costs blood here. Leave now and bleed elsewhere.

negative: Solicitation and slander, logged. Posture upgraded. You have ten seconds of goodwill left. Spend them on distance.
You accused this command of corruption to its face. Response authorized. Response imminent. Move.
neutral: That crossed from insult into incident. Incident response is not a conversation. Clear the sector now.
Integrity test failed — yours. Sound the walk-away alarm in your head and obey it.
positive: I liked you, and you just made me draft your incident report. Get off my perimeter before I finish it.
Wrong officer to buy, friend. The word friend is now under review. Go. Now.

negative: You offered coin for honor inside our own shade. The shade withdraws. What remains is sun and knives.
The viper takes no wages and many payments. Yours begins now. Run toward the horizon of your choice.
neutral: Some words unpitch the tent. Yours just did. The desert between us is no longer neutral ground.
You mistook patience for a market stall. The error will be corrected in the old way. Flee it.
positive: Even for a friend there are doors with no other side. You knocked. Now the knives answer. Go.
The fire you sat at remembers you fondly. The blades do not consult the fire. Leave while they argue.
